questions: Which orthopaedics practices in Treptow-Köpenick have which waiting times per channel?
Which rules on open consultation, the appointment service and GP referrals apply?

sql.Which orthopaedics practices in Treptow-: SELECT p.practice_id, p.name, p.district, w.channel, w.days_to_appointment, p.sample FROM FT_PRACTICES.practices p JOIN FT_WAITS.waits w ON p.practice_id = w.practice_id WHERE lower(p.specialty) = 'orthopaedics' AND p.district = 'Treptow-Köpenick' ORDER BY w.days_to_appointment
sql.Which rules on open consultation, the ap: SELECT rule_id, topic, rule, legal_basis FROM FT_RULES.rules WHERE topic IN ('open consultation', 'appointment service', 'GP referral') ORDER BY rule_id

sql_default: SELECT rule_id, topic, rule, legal_basis FROM FT_RULES.rules

routes.route: Walk in to the open consultation of Sample Practice Orthopaedics Köpenick (SAMPLE data)
routes.why: The sample waiting data shows an open consultation at this Treptow-Köpenick orthopaedics practice with 0 days to an appointment (E1). Orthopaedic practices hold at least five hours of open consultation per week without appointment (E6).

routes.route: Ask your GP to arrange an urgent appointment, then use the appointment service 116117 (SAMPLE data)
routes.why: Without an urgency code the appointment service has no four-week duty (E3). A GP can arrange an urgent specialist appointment (E7); with an urgent referral the appointment service must offer one within four weeks (E3).
